is_abstract.description: If true, this profile is a template or abstract definition not intended to be directly assigned to a beamline element. Concrete profiles that refine a template should set this to false (the default).

Relationship.description: A directed edge type in the NARAD graph projection, modelled after the OBO Relation Ontology (RO) ObjectProperty metamodel. Each relationship carries an identifier, human-readable label, natural-language description, and explicit domain/range node-type constraints.

asymmetric.description: True if the relation is asymmetric: if A rel B then NOT B rel A.

domain.description: The node type that can appear as the subject (source) of this relationship.

irreflexive.description: True if no entity can stand in this relation to itself.

range.description: The node type that can appear as the object (target) of this relationship.

subproperty_of.description: Parent relationships of which this is a more specific sub-relation.

symmetric.description: True if the relation is symmetric: if A rel B then B rel A.

transitive.description: True if the relation is transitive: if A rel B and B rel C then A rel C.

Relationship.title: Relationship

RelationshipTypeEnum.description: Allowed relationship types in the NARAD graph projection; each corresponds to an RO (Relation Ontology)-inspired directed edge.
RelationshipTypeEnum.title: RelationshipTypeEnum

Signal.description: A named semantic signal used by a capability.

data_type.description: The data type of the signal's value.

role.description: The semantic role of the signal within its capability.

units.description: Conventional unit symbol (e.g. A, MV/m, T*m, G/cm).

units_uri.description: Machine-resolvable QUDT unit reference (e.g. si-unit:A for Ampere, si-unit:MegaV-PER-M for MV/m, si-unit:T-M for T*m). The si-unit: prefix maps to http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/. Companion to the human-readable symbol in the units slot. Use the narad:CustomUnit for user-defined units not in QUDT; these should be defined in the graph projection with a narad:CustomUnit class and linked to signals via the units_uri slot.

TypeSpecificCapability.description: An inline capability declared within a device-type profile, with its own identifier, a semantic class label, a description, and a list of signals. Distinct from the shared capabilities referenced by name; these are profile-local definitions.

capability_class.description: Semantic class label for a type-specific capability (e.g. QuadrupoleStrengthCapability). Serialized as 'class' in source YAML; renamed here to avoid conflict with reserved keywords.

class_curie.description: Optional machine-resolvable URI or CURIE for a TypeSpecificCapability class. Use the narad: prefix for NARAD-defined classes (e.g. narad:QuadrupoleStrengthCapability), or any registered prefix for externally defined capability types. New capability classes can be introduced freely by using a suitable namespace.
